lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: Vitest frontend tests (tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} minus *.slow.test.*; jsdom by default, node per file per ADR-0049). No external services.

lanes.name: slow
lanes.description: Vitest slow tier (tests/**/*.slow.test.{ts,tsx}): exhaustive, property and cost-enumeration sweeps excluded from the unit lane (ADR-0050). Coverage stays with the unit lane.
lanes.command: scripts/heavy-lock.sh pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.slow.config.ts

lanes.name: rust
lanes.description: cargo test for the Tauri backend: #[cfg(test)] units, tests/render_golden.rs, doc tests.

lanes.name: rust-verify-run
lanes.description: cargo test with --features verify-run (ADR-0047): compiles the feature-gated verify_run* modules and their tests, which the plain rust lane never builds. Not a superset of the rust lane: wi6_t01 (shipping MCP port 55045) is feature-off only.

criticalPaths.description: Link scheme allowlist and app-origin comparison (ADR-0001, ADR-0002). A defect here hands an attacker-chosen URL to the OS opener; measured 34/34 lines and 26/26 branches when pinned.
Sole caller of the link gates; routes every WYSIWYG link click and decides what reaches the OS opener. Measured 67/67 lines and 23/23 branches when pinned.

The heading-key matcher (WI-3.5.2): the only place the `headingKey` coordination contract in src/types/toc.ts is executed. A missed branch here silently hands one heading's collapse/active state to another, which the user cannot see happen.
